pages.text: Snow had fallen all night. The yard was white, without a single mark.
"I'll draw a big circle in the snow." Yuki ran outside.
Running, Yuki stamped their feet. Crunch, crunch. "I'll draw it quickly!"
Yuki went this way and that. Footprints filled the yard.
Momo ran after Yuki, mixing in pawprints. "Don't step there, Momo!"
From the porch, Yuki looked down. All the footprints were tangled together.
No circle could be seen. "Where did mine go?"
Grandma asked, "Which of all these footprints came first?" Yuki looked at the yard for a long time.
Untouched snow remained on the far side. Yuki stepped slowly, one foot at a time. Crunch. Crunch.
From the porch, one circle showed in the snow. Momo walked along its line.
